info.title: API.SH: eBay
info.description: The eBay API from API.SH: public eBay data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A member's feedback profile: comments (25 a page, eBay's own paging), rating counts and detailed seller ratings. Give the member's user id, or a store name (resolved to its owner through the store's Feedback tab). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebay-feedback

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: eBay user id (the name in ebay.com/usr/<id> or fdbk/feedback_profile/<id>).

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: eBay store name (ebay.com/str/<name>), used when username is not given.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Time window (default all; 12m when rating is set, as on eBay).

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Feedback received as seller (default) or as buyer.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One listing: price, condition, seller feedback, quantity available and sold, watchers, item specifics, shipping, delivery, returns, item location, ships-to list, images and the seller description URL. Multi-variation listings also return `variations` (null otherwise): every variation's id, options (e.g. Size, Color), price, out-of-stock flag, quantity available and sold, watchers and image. `variation_id` opens the listing on one variation; `site` (or the link's domain) reads it from another eBay country site.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebay-item

parameters.name: variation_id
parameters.description: A variation id from `variations[].id`: the listing as shown with that variation selected (price, quantity).

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: eBay country site (default us, or the domain of `url`): us, uk, de, au, ca, fr, it, es.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: A 5-digit US ZIP code: adds `shipping_to_zip` (whether the item ships there, the shipping text and cost as eBay shows it for that ZIP, free-shipping flag, delivery line). US site only; adds one more page read.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Listings for a query on ebay.com (or another eBay country site with `site`) with eBay's own sort and filters: price range, condition, buying format, free shipping, returns, sold listings, item location, category, one seller's listings, item specifics (`aspect=Brand:Apple`), listed/ending time windows, authorized sellers, deals and sale items, free returns, fast delivery, local pickup, Authenticity Guarantee, lots, charity, title-and-description match, excluded words, word matching, bid range, and a ship-to ZIP with an optional radius. 60 listings per page by default (`per_page` 120 or 240); pass `next_page` back as `page`. On another country site, `price_value` and `currency` are in that site's currency and item links point to that site.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebay-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (60 listings per page). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: best_match (default), price_asc, price_desc, newest, ending_soon, distance.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: new, open_box, refurbished, used or parts.

parameters.name: sold
parameters.description: 1 for sold and completed listings (price history). eBay currently shows these only to signed-in visitors, so this returns 422 (not charged).

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: eBay country site (default us = ebay.com): us, uk (ebay.co.uk), de, au (ebay.com.au), ca, fr, it, es. Prices are in the site's currency (`min_price` / `max_price` too).

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Only listings of this seller (their eBay user id).

parameters.name: aspect
parameters.description: Item-specific filter as Name:value, as eBay's filter panel names them, e.g. `Brand:Apple` or `Storage Capacity:256 GB`. Repeat the parameter (or separate with ;) for several; several values of one name match any of them. Max 10.

parameters.name: listed_within
parameters.description: Only listings started within this many hours (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 12, 24, 48, 72, 96, 120, 144, 168) or days (1d-7d).

parameters.name: ending_within
parameters.description: Only listings ending within this many hours or days (same values as listed_within).

parameters.name: ending_after
parameters.description: Only listings ending in more than this many hours or days (same values). One of listed_within, ending_within, ending_after at a time.

parameters.name: authenticity_guarantee
parameters.description: Only items with the Authenticity Guarantee.

parameters.name: search_description
parameters.description: Match the words in titles and descriptions.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Words to exclude, as eBay applies them.

parameters.name: min_bids
parameters.description: Auctions with at least this many bids.

parameters.name: max_bids
parameters.description: Auctions with at most this many bids.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: Ship-to postal code: shipping costs on the cards are for this place (US site).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: With zip: only items within this many miles.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A seller's profile: feedback score, positive feedback percentage over the last 12 months, member since, location, business-seller status, feedback counts for the last 1, 6 and 12 months, and the detailed seller ratings (item as described, shipping cost, shipping speed, communication) with their rating counts. Give the seller's user id, or a store name (resolved to its owner). Add `items_for_sale=true` for the number of live listings of a store seller.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebay-seller

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: eBay user id (the name in ebay.com/usr/<id>).

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: eBay store name (ebay.com/str/<name>), used when username is not given.

parameters.name: items_for_sale
parameters.description: Also return the number of live listings (store sellers; one extra lookup).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebay-store

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Store name, as in ebay.com/str/<name>. Either name or url is required.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The listings of one eBay Store, page by page (48 per page) with the store's own sort and filters: each listing's id, title, link, price (and the top of a price range), original price, promotion lines and image; plus the store's own categories (id, name, link) to pass back as `category`, the store name and its number of listings for sale. Search inside the store with `q` (the listings then come in the search-result shape of `/ebay/v1/search`, with `total_results`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebay-store-items

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A store link instead of name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
